title: Shirdi Ke Sai Baba
desc: A doctor visits Shirdi with his ailing son, torn between faith and science. To save his child, he must decide if Sai Baba's blessings hold the cure he desperately seeks.

title: Himmatwala (1983)
desc: Ravi, an engineer, promises to restore his father's lost reputation. Meanwhile, the daughter of his enemy, Sher Singh, falls in love with him and helps him trick her father.

title: Rustom
desc: Rustom is a navy officer happily married to Cynthia. When he finds out she's cheating with his friend Vikram, things turn tragic, and Rustom is blamed for murder.

title: Dhadak
desc: Madhu and Parthavi fall in love despite social differences. Families oppose them, forcing the couple to elope, while her father and brother chase relentlessly, testing their bond.

title: Dream Girl
desc: Karamveer lands a call-center job thanks to his knack for mimicking a woman's voice. Fame follows, but trouble brews as obsessed clients push him into dangerous territory.

title: Baazigar
desc: Ajay Sharma seduces and kills a businessman's daughter, staging it as a suicide. He then plots to destroy the entire family, driven by a cold vendetta.

title: Dunki
desc: A group of friends risk everything to reach the UK through a dangerous route called 'donkey flight', facing life-threatening challenges and the harsh reality of illegal immigration.

title: Ghoomer
desc: Anina, a young cricket star, loses her right hand before her debut. With help from a failed cricketer and creative training, she becomes a bowler and invents a new style.

title: Bhoot Returns
desc: Tarun and Namrata move into a luxurious bungalow with their children, Taman and Nimmi. But mysterious events soon threaten their lives, forcing them to escape for survival.

title: Ankhiyon Ke Jharokhon Se
desc: College rivals Lily and Arun fall in love with their parents' support, but their dreams shatter when she is diagnosed with leukaemia, testing their strength and bond.

title: Saaho
desc: An undercover agent and his partner chase a thief who stole 2,000 crore. Soon, they uncover links to a crime lord's death and a brewing gang war.

title: Hum Aapke Hain Kaun
desc: Prem and Nisha fall in love through family celebrations, but after tragedy, duty and family expectations challenge their chance at happiness.

title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary reunites with a British officer he once shared a bond with. Together, they set aside differences to fight despotic rulers, forging an inspiring path to freedom.

title: Andaz Apna Apna
desc: Two ambitious rivals chase wealth by pursuing an heiress, but their plans spiral into confusion when a family plot and hidden identity create unexpected trouble.

title: Singh Is King
desc: Happy, known for his wild antics, is sent to bring Lakhan to his ailing father. In Australia, events take a turn as Happy accidentally assumes Lakhan's role as the local underworld king.

title: Murder 2
desc: Arjun, a former cop, takes on the case of missing sex workers. To catch the culprit, young Reshma bravely steps in as bait-risking everything to expose the truth.
